newsitem.title: USA: Kentucky Utilities sets record summer power demand.
newsitem.headline: Kentucky Utilities sets record summer power demand.

text.p: Kentucky Utilities Co said Tuesday it set a new summer peak electricity demand of 3,358 megawatts (MW) on its system Monday at 1400 EDT as heat blanketed the region.
This record demand replaced the previous summer peak of 3,341 MW, set Aug 16, 1995.
The overall record peak, set Feb 6, 1996, is 3,391 MW.
Kentucky Utilities Co, based in Lexington, serves more than 464,000 customers in 77 Kentucky counties and five counties in Virginia.
KU is the principal subsidiary of KU Energy Corp.
